g.text: Elmo Is Going as Meryl Streep’s Evil Fashion Editor Miranda Priestly for Halloween This Year ◆ Jafar Panahi Now Faces a Five-Year Prison Term in New Ruling on Top of His Previous One-Year Conviction ◆ Bunny Levine’s Final Film ‘Omi’ Premieres at Austin Film Festival – Watch the Trailer – Film News in Brief ◆ Connor Storrie in Talks to Play Villain Opposite Ryan Gosling in Marvel’s ‘Ghost Rider’ ◆ Kevin Bleyer, Emmy-winning ‘Daily Show’ Writer, Dies at 54 in Car Accident ◆ ‘Crystal Lake’ Hits 1.3 Billion Minutes Watched in 11 Days, Becoming Peacock’s No. 4 Scripted Debut Ever ◆
